name: Icon Gallery
description: Sariah's Icon Gallery website now in GD!

auto-unzip.name: Unzip automatically
auto-unzip.description: Disables the alert and the mod goes straight into unzipping the sprites from downloaded Zip packages.

icon-pack-folder.name: Icons Pack Folder
icon-pack-folder.description:
It's the folder location where downloaded icons will be placed (after unzipping). It's heavily recommended to be a pack from <cg>Texture Loader</c>.
***
The mod will create a pack folder if no custom one is provided.
